description: This file defines the ContextProxy class for managing VSCode extension context, including state, secrets, configuration migration, and event handling.

classes.name: ContextProxy
classes.description: Manages VSCode extension context, including state, secrets, configuration migration, and event handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads existing state and secrets, performs migrations, and sets the initialized flag.

methods.name: migrateInvalidApiProvider
methods.description: Clears invalid API provider values from storage.

methods.name: migrateImageGenerationSettings
methods.description: Migrates old nested image generation settings to a flattened structure.

methods.name: getGlobalState
methods.description: Retrieves a global state value, with optional default.

methods.name: storeSecret
methods.description: Stores or deletes a secret value.

methods.name: refreshSecrets
methods.description: Refreshes secrets from storage into cache.

methods.name: getProviderSettings
methods.description: Returns validated provider settings, sanitizing invalid values.

methods.name: setProviderSettings
methods.description: Sets provider settings and emits configuration change events if needed.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports global settings, excluding project-specific modes.

methods.name: resetAllState
methods.description: Resets all state, secrets, and caches, then re-initializes.
